name: Standard Product Return Window
rule: Customers can initiate returns within 30 calendar days of delivery for eligible hardware and electronics.

name: High-Value Refund Human-in-the-Loop Threshold
rule: Any refund request exceeding $500.00 USD must not be automatically disbursed by AI. It mandates explicit manual review and approval by a Finance Operations Manager.

name: Customer Recovery Promotional Discount Ceiling
rule: Automated customer win-back discount campaigns are capped at 15.0%. Discounts exceeding 15% require VP of Sales executive sign-off to protect product gross margin.

name: Customer Tier Classification & Benefits
rule: Customer tiers are deterministically assigned based on lifetime spend: Platinum ($5,000+), Gold ($2,500-$4,999), Silver ($1,000-$2,499), Standard (<$1,000).

name: Inactive Customer & Churn Alert Definition
rule: Customers with no successful orders in the last 60 calendar days are classified as 'Inactive'. Customers inactive for 90+ days with lifetime spend > $2,000 are flagged as 'High-Value Churn Risk'.

name: Autonomous Database Mutability Safeguard
rule: Autonomous AI agents are strictly granted read-only analytical access. Agents are forbidden from directly executing SQL UPDATE, DELETE, or INSERT statements on transactional ledgers.

name: Product Quality & Return Rate Quarantine
rule: Any tech hardware SKU with a 30-day return rate exceeding 8.0% or defective return count > 15 units must be flagged for Quality Engineering audit and supplier review.
